name: @pipeworx/mcp-squiggle

tools.name: teams
tools.description: List all AFL teams tracked by Squiggle, optionally filtered to a specific year; returns team IDs, names, and abbreviations used across other tools.

tools.name: games
tools.description: Fetch AFL fixture and results from Squiggle, filtered by year, round, and/or completion status; returns scores, venues, dates, and match IDs.

tools.name: standings
tools.description: Fetch the AFL ladder (standings) for a given year and optional round from Squiggle; returns wins, losses, points, and percentage for each team.

tools.name: sources
tools.description: List all registered AFL tipping sources in Squiggle (models, pundits, bookmakers) with their numeric IDs; use IDs with `tips` and `ladder`.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-squiggle forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the squiggle pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
